New CharactersNew CharactersNew Characters

Modern loanwords need sounds that don't exist in traditional Japanese, so small vowel characters combine with ウ/ト/ド/ツ to approximate them. These are essential for JLPT N5–N4 reading, since they appear constantly in everyday katakana vocabulary.Modern loanwords need sounds that don't exist in traditional Japanese, so small vowel characters combine with ウ/ト/ド/ツ to approximate them. These are essential for JLPT N5–N4 reading, since they appear constantly in everyday katakana vocabulary.Modern loanwords need sounds that don't exist in traditional Japanese, so small vowel characters combine with ウ/ト/ド/ツ to approximate them. These are essential for JLPT N5–N4 reading, since they appear constantly in everyday katakana vocabulary.
